# 05 - Opportunity Mapping

Handed to Phase 12 (`08_Feature_Gap`). The input here is deliberately narrow:
24 usable records cannot support a large feature roadmap, and
pretending otherwise would be the same overreach this phase spent its time
correcting elsewhere.

![Pain to capability](../_exports/charts/phase11/p11_08_pain_to_capability.png)

## Supported by evidence

| Opportunity | Evidence | Strength |
|---|---|---|
| **One system, not five** | ICUBE institutional record; 6-year practitioner; `FRAGMENTATION` is the only category with independent multi-source support | **Strong** |
| **Simpler by default** | 5 independent Accubate complaints about too many modules / options | **Moderate** |
| **Founder outreach that reaches** | Accubate: email to spam, requests SMS/WhatsApp | **Moderate** |
| **Documentation as a product** | "No User manual!! ... 18 months" | **Moderate, single source** |
| **Small-institution tier** | IdeaScale: "challenging for small firm", "expensive in the wrong organization" | **Weak** |

## Not supported by evidence

| Tempting claim | Why it is not made |
|---|---|
| "Nobody has solved AI-driven incubation" | One reviewer asked for AI. That is a feature request, not a market gap. |
| "Reporting is broken across the category" | Three weak signals, none from an institutional user |
| "Integrations are missing" | Two IdeaScale reviewers, both enterprise engineering contexts, not incubation |
| "Indian institutions need local-language tools" | One vendor (NestLens Orbit) offers Sarvam AI; **no user in the corpus asked for it** |

## The honest strategic read

The evidence supports a wedge that is **narrower and more operational** than the
vendor positioning in this category:

1. **Consolidation** - genuinely evidenced, three independent routes.
2. **Restraint** - the one thing vendors in this category systematically fail at.
3. **Adoption** - the unclaimed gap, currently invisible because it cannot be
   researched from review sites.

The AI and reporting pitches that dominate this market's homepages have **no
support in user voice**. That is not a reason to avoid them; it is a reason to know
they are being made on instinct, and to treat them as bets rather than findings.

## The uncomfortable implication

Phase 11 did not deliver what it was commissioned to deliver. It was commissioned to
find what users hate, and the answer is that users do not hate anything here -
including, in the case of two reviewers, Google Forms, which they left behind.

The corpus is 24 usable records. **A primary-research programme is
still the only way to answer the questions this phase could not.** See
[06_Limitations.md](06_Limitations.md).
